title: General Triangle (विषमबाहु त्रिभुज)
front: General Triangle (Sides $a, b, c$): Perimeter, Heron's Area, Sine Area, Inradius ($r$) & Circumradius ($R$)?
back:
• Perimeter $= a + b + c$,   $s = \frac{a+b+c}{2}$
• Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{Base} \times \text{Height} = \frac{1}{2}ab\sin\theta$
• Heron's Area $= \sqrt{s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)}$
• $r = \frac{\text{Area}}{s}$,   $R = \frac{abc}{4 \times \text{Area}}$
trick: Jab do sides aur unke beech ka angle $\theta$ diya ho to seedha $\frac{1}{2}ab\sin\theta$ lagayein.

title: Right-Angled Triangle (समकोण त्रिभुज)
front: Right-Angled Triangle (Base $b$, Height $p$, Hypotenuse $h$): Area, Inradius ($r$), Circumradius ($R$) & Altitude on Hypotenuse?
back:
• $h^2 = p^2 + b^2$  |  Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times b \times p$
• Inradius $(r) = \frac{p + b - h}{2}$
• Circumradius $(R) = \frac{h}{2}$
• Altitude on Hypotenuse $= \frac{p \times b}{h}$
trick: Circumradius hamesha Hypotenuse ka half ($h/2$) hota hai, aur standard triplets (3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17, 7-24-25) yaad rakhein.

title: Equilateral Triangle (समबाहु त्रिभुज)
front: Equilateral Triangle (Side = $a$): Perimeter, Height ($h$), Area, Inradius ($r$) & Circumradius ($R$)?
back:
• Perimeter $= 3a$  |  Height $(h) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}a$
• Area $= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}a^2 = \frac{h^2}{\sqrt{3}}$
• $r = \frac{a}{2\sqrt{3}}$,   $R = \frac{a}{\sqrt{3}}$
trick: Ratio yaad rakhein: $r : R = 1 : 2$, aur unke Areas ka ratio $= 1 : 4$.

title: Equilateral Triangle — Internal Point
front: Agar Equilateral Triangle ke andar kisi point se teeno sides par perpendiculars $p_1, p_2, p_3$ hon, to Height ($h$) aur Side ($a$) kya hogi?
back:
• Height $(h) = p_1 + p_2 + p_3$
• Side $(a) = \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}(p_1 + p_2 + p_3)$
trick: Teeno perpendiculars ka sum hi triangle ki total height hoti hai.

title: Isosceles Triangle (समद्विबाहु त्रिभुज)
front: Isosceles Triangle (Equal sides = $a$, Base = $b$): Perimeter, Height ($h$) & Area?
back:
• Perimeter $= 2a + b$
• Height $(h) = \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{4a^2 - b^2}$
• Area $= \frac{b}{4}\sqrt{4a^2 - b^2}$
trick: Base $b$ ko aadha ($b/2$) karke Pythagoras se height nikalna formula ratne se tez hota hai.

title: Isosceles Right-Angled Triangle
front: Isosceles Right-Angled Triangle (Equal sides = $a$, Hypotenuse = $h$): Hypotenuse & Area?
back:
• Hypotenuse $(h) = a\sqrt{2}$
• Area $= \frac{a^2}{2} = \frac{h^2}{4}$
trick: Hypotenuse diya ho to direct Area $= \frac{h^2}{4}$ lagayein.

title: Square (वर्ग)
front: Square (Side = $a$, Diagonal = $d$): Perimeter, Diagonal, Area, Inradius ($r$) & Circumradius ($R$)?
back:
• Perimeter $= 4a$  |  Diagonal $(d) = a\sqrt{2}$
• Area $= a^2 = \frac{d^2}{2}$
• $r = \frac{a}{2}$,   $R = \frac{a}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{d}{2}$
trick: Diagonal diya ho to seedha Area $= \frac{d^2}{2}$ lagayein.

title: Rectangle (आयत)
front: Rectangle (Length = $l$, Breadth = $b$): Perimeter, Diagonal ($d$) & Area?
back:
• Perimeter $= 2(l + b)$
• Diagonal $(d) = \sqrt{l^2 + b^2}$
• Area $= l \times b$
trick: $l, b, d$ hamesha Right-Angle Triplet banate hain.

title: Parallelogram (समांतर चतुर्भुज)
front: Parallelogram (Sides $a, b$, Diagonals $d_1, d_2$): Perimeter, Area & Diagonal Relation?
back:
• Perimeter $= 2(a + b)$
• Area $= \text{Base} \times \text{Height} = ab\sin\theta$
• Diagonal Relation: $d_1^2 + d_2^2 = 2(a^2 + b^2)$
trick: SSC me $d_1^2 + d_2^2 = 2(a^2 + b^2)$ par direct question bahut aata hai.

title: Rhombus (समचतुर्भुज)
front: Rhombus (Side = $a$, Diagonals $d_1, d_2$): Perimeter, Area & Side–Diagonal Relation?
back:
• Perimeter $= 4a$
• Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times d_1 \times d_2 = a \times h = a^2\sin\theta$
• Side–Diagonal Relation: $4a^2 = d_1^2 + d_2^2$
trick: Diagonals 90° par bisect karte hain, isliye $\frac{d_1}{2}, \frac{d_2}{2}, a$ hamesha triplet banate hain.

title: Trapezium (समलंब चतुर्भुज)
front: Trapezium (Parallel sides $a, b$, Height $h$): Area?
back: • Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times (a + b) \times h$
trick: Parallel sides ka average $\times$ unke beech ki perpendicular distance ($h$).

title: General & Cyclic Quadrilateral
front: General Quadrilateral (Diagonal $d$, Heights $h_1, h_2$) & Cyclic Quadrilateral (Sides $a, b, c, d$): Area?
back:
• General Quad Area $= \frac{1}{2} \times d \times (h_1 + h_2)$
• Cyclic Quad ($s = \frac{a+b+c+d}{2}$):
Area $= \sqrt{(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)(s-d)}$
trick: Cyclic Quad ka formula bilkul Heron's formula jaisa hai, bas shuru ka '$s$' nahi hota.

title: Circle (वृत्त)
front: Circle (Radius = $r$, Diameter = $d$): Circumference & Area?
back:
• Diameter $(d) = 2r$
• Circumference $(C) = 2\pi r = \pi d$
• Area $= \pi r^2 = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}$
trick: Standard Table: $r = 7 \Rightarrow C = 44,\ A = 154$. Radius $k$ guna hone par $C$ $k$ guna aur Area $k^2$ guna hota hai.

title: Semi-Circle (अर्धवृत्त)
front: Semi-Circle (Radius = $r$): Area & Perimeter?
back:
• Area $= \frac{1}{2}\pi r^2$
• Perimeter $= \pi r + 2r = \frac{36}{7}r$
trick: Perimeter me $+2r$ jodna mat bhoolna! Direct: $r = 7 \Rightarrow \text{Perimeter} = 36$.

title: Quadrant of Circle (चतुर्थांश)
front: Quadrant ($\theta = 90^\circ$, Radius = $r$): Area & Perimeter?
back:
• Area $= \frac{1}{4}\pi r^2$
• Perimeter $= \frac{\pi r}{2} + 2r = \frac{25}{7}r$
trick: Direct ratio: $r = 7 \Rightarrow \text{Perimeter} = 25$.

title: Sector & Arc (त्रिज्यखंड और चाप)
front: Sector (Radius = $r$, Angle = $\theta$): Arc Length ($l$), Area & Perimeter?
back:
• Arc Length $(l) = \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times 2\pi r$
• Area $= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{1}{2} \times l \times r$
• Perimeter $= l + 2r$
trick: Arc length $l$ aur radius $r$ diya ho to seedha Area $= \frac{1}{2}lr$ lagayein.

title: Segment of a Circle (वृत्तखंड)
front: Minor Segment (Radius = $r$, Angle = $\theta$): Area?
back:
• Area of Minor Segment $= \text{Area of Sector} - \text{Area of Triangle}$
$= \frac{\theta}{360^\circ}\pi r^2 - \frac{1}{2}r^2\sin\theta$
trick: Sector ke area me se triangle ka area ($\frac{1}{2}r^2\sin\theta$) minus kar dein.

title: Concentric Circles / Ring (वृत्ताकार वलय)
front: Circular Ring (Outer Radius = $R$, Inner Radius = $r$): Area & Width?
back:
• Area of Ring $= \pi(R^2 - r^2) = \pi(R + r)(R - r)$
• Width of Ring $= R - r$
trick: Hamesha $(R+r)(R-r)$ use karein — calculation seconds me ho jayegi.

title: Wheel Revolution (पहिए के चक्कर)
front: Wheel of Radius $r$: Distance in 1 Revolution & Total Number of Revolutions?
back:
• Distance in 1 Revolution $= 2\pi r$
• Number of Revolutions $= \frac{\text{Total Distance}}{2\pi r}$
trick: Units (cm, m, km) ko pehle same unit me convert zaroor kar lein.

title: Regular Polygon (समबहुभुज — $n$ sides)
front: Regular Polygon ($n$ sides, side = $a$): Interior Angle, Exterior Angle, Diagonals & Area?
back:
• Sum of Interior Angles $= (n - 2) \times 180^\circ$
• Each Interior Angle $= \frac{(n - 2) \times 180^\circ}{n}$
• Each Exterior Angle $= \frac{360^\circ}{n}$ (Sum $= 360^\circ$)
• Diagonals $= \frac{n(n - 3)}{2}$  |  Area $= \frac{na^2}{4}\cot\left(\frac{180^\circ}{n}\right)$
trick: Interior + Exterior Angle $= 180^\circ$ hota hai — isse sides ($n$) turant nikal aati hain.

title: Regular Hexagon (समषट्भुज)
front: Regular Hexagon (Side = $a$): Perimeter, Area, Inradius ($r$) & Circumradius ($R$)?
back:
• Perimeter $= 6a$
• Area $= 6 \times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}a^2 = \frac{3\sqrt{3}}{2}a^2$
• Inradius $(r) = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}a$,   Circumradius $(R) = a$
trick: Regular Hexagon 6 identical Equilateral Triangles se milkar banta hai.

title: Regular Octagon (समअष्टभुज)
front: Regular Octagon (Side = $a$): Area?
trick: Direct formula yaad rakhein: $2a^2(\sqrt{2} + 1)$.

title: Path Around Rectangle (रास्ते का क्षेत्रफल)
front: Path of width $w$ around Rectangle ($l \times b$): Outside, Inside & Crossroads Area?
back:
• Outside Path Area $= 2w(l + b + 2w)$
• Inside Path Area $= 2w(l + b - 2w)$
• Crossroads (Middle Path) Area $= w(l + b - w)$
trick: Outside me $+2w$, Inside me $-2w$, aur Crossroads me sirf $w(l + b - w)$.

title: Special Shaded Areas (SSC Favorites)
front: Shaded Area: 3 Touching Circles, 4 Touching Circles, Leaf inside Square ($a$) & Square-Circle Ratio?
back:
• 3 Equal Circles ($r$): $r^2\left(\sqrt{3} - \frac{\pi}{2}\right) \approx 0.161r^2$
• 4 Equal Circles ($r$): $r^2(4 - \pi) = \frac{6}{7}r^2$
• Leaf inside Square ($a$): $a^2\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 1\right) = \frac{4}{7}a^2$
• Square : Inscribed Circle $= 4 : \pi = 14 : 11$
trick: Direct fractions yaad rakhein: 4 circles $= \frac{6}{7}r^2$, Leaf $= \frac{4}{7}a^2$, Square : Circle $= 14 : 11$.
